description: Kubernetes manifest cross-reference check — Parses up to 20 Kubernetes YAML manifests and checks that they agree with each other, for an agent that generated or edited manifests before kubectl apply: Service selectors against pod template labels (with the nearest near-miss), named targetPorts against containerPort names, Service port naming, Deployment selector against its template labels, Ingress backends against Services, and ConfigMap/Se

closedWorld.description: Declare that the manifests are the complete set: a reference to an object that is not supplied then fails instead of staying unverified.

manifests.description: YAML text, multi-document allowed. At most 24000 characters in total (the parser costs about 1 ms per 1,000 characters).

name: k8s-crosscheck
